verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships a dedicated `writing-skills` meta-skill that teaches the agent to author and test new skills. It frames skill writing as TDD: write pressure-scenario tests, watch them fail, write the skill, watch agents comply, then refactor to close loopholes. That covers both writing and improving, and is backed by an evals harness that judges skill compliance in real sessions. Packaging guidance is thin: beyond a note on the cross-runtime `~/.agents/skills/` install location, the evidence shows nothing on how the meta-skill guides bundling or distribution. Missing for 10: explicit packaging/distribution guidance within the meta-skill, independent or hands-on corroboration of the writing-skills workflow.
